summary_1line: Guha offers to guard Rama as he sleeps on the riverbank, but Lakshmana insists on keeping vigil, lamenting Rama’s hardship and fearing grief in Ayodhya.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama and Sita sleep on a simple bed of straw by the sacred river while Lakshmana stands awake with bow in hand under the night sky.
Guha, the Nishada chief, speaks softly to Lakshmana beside a dim riverside campfire while the forest and river lie silent around them.
Lakshmana gazes sorrowfully at the sleeping Rama on the ground, imagining the grieving palace of Ayodhya far away.
